basic_info.description: Charming Duplex with Endless Possibilities. Discover this versatile mixed-use property offering exceptional potential for both homeowners and investors. The front unit, currently vacant, was previously a storefront rented for $2,100 per month, making the current cap rate close to 7%. Meanwhile it comes with a ready-to-pull permit to convert into a spacious 2 bed, 1 bath unit, complete with architect-drafted floor plans permit ready to pull. This makes it an excellent opportunity to repurpose as residential or maintain as a commercial storefront. The back unit is a well-maintained 2 bed, 1 office, 1 bath unit, currently tenant-occupied and generating stable rental income of $2,515 per month. With market-rate rents for each unit averaging around $3,300, this property offers significant upside potential for increased cash flow through forced appreciation producing close to 10% cap rate. Whether you are an investor seeking steady income or a buyer looking to maximize value, the possibilities are endless. Perfectly situated in a prime location, close to shopping, popular restaurants, and major commute routes, highly desirable for tenants and homeowners alike. Don't miss this chance to own a versatile, income-producing property in a convenient and sought-after area.
